name: Leopold Stavizzi
source:
“You are not like the other ladies here… It is a welcome change.”
Cool, calm and collected, Duke Leopold is one of the few young men in attendance. He seems to have his own reasons for attending the celebrations outside of the usual entertainments, though what they are is anyone’s guess.
